output.phoneNote: The tall hero image followed by an oversized headline consumes the first screen without presenting a complete service message.
output.desktopNote: The six-line hero headline pushes the contact buttons below the first screen, while sparse lower sections create an uneven rhythm.
fixes: Rebalance the hero: on phone, place a smaller headline before a shorter image; on desktop, reduce headline size and widen its column so the message and primary call button fit above the fold.
Replace the large landscape image with glazing work or a workshop detail, making the supporting imagery specific to the trade rather than the region.
Tighten the lower-page layout by grouping opening hours with contact details and reducing the large gaps between headings, supporting text and sections.
